The method

From first conversation to forgotten.

Four stages. A few weeks in, you stop thinking about your hair.

  1. I

    Private consultation

    An honest look at your hair, scalp and routine. If a system is not right for you, we say so.

  2. II

    Design

    Your scalp is templated, your hairline drawn, the hair and colour chosen with you.

  3. III

    Fitting

    Attached, cut and styled in one sitting. You leave wearing it.

  4. IV

    Maintenance

    Regular visits to clean, re-attach and restyle, on a schedule set with you.

Living with it

The questions everyone asks first.

Anything not answered here, ask us on WhatsApp.

Will people be able to tell?

Not in everyday life. The system is matched to your colour, density and wave, the hairline is drawn for your face and age, and it is cut into your own hair so there is no visible edge. You see the result in the mirror before you leave.

Can I sleep, shower, swim and go to the gym?

Yes. Professional attachment holds through sleep, showers, workouts and swimming. You wash it much like your own hair, and we show you how at your fitting.

Is it surgery? Does it hurt?

No. Nothing is implanted and there are no needles, no medication and no recovery time. The system sits on the scalp and is attached with professional adhesive or tape.

What does it cost?

It depends on the area covered, the base, and the length and density of hair. We give you an exact price at your consultation, before you commit to anything. The consultation itself is complimentary.

How often do I need to come back?

At regular intervals, for a clean, re-attachment and restyle. The exact interval depends on the base and on your routine, and we set it with you at your fitting.

How do I look after it at home?
  • Wash with the sulfate-free products we recommend, and not every day.
  • Detangle with a wide-tooth comb, working up from the ends.
  • Pat dry with a towel instead of rubbing, and air-dry when you can.
  • Keep heat styling low and use a heat protectant.
  • Cover up in strong sun to protect the colour.
What happens at the first consultation?

A private, unhurried conversation with a technician. We look at your hair and scalp, show you bases and hair samples, answer every question, and give you a price. There is no obligation to book a fitting.
